d: Young love can be a beautiful time but when jealousy raises its ugly head it can also be deadly.
To the outside world their marriages seemed happy. They were loving parents living comfortable lives.
A look at an ex-marine who gets the urge to kill after spotting Amyjane.
Two prominent doctors that are two towns apart are entangled in a passionate rivalry for the same woman's affections.
A look at the appearance of severed body parts in random locations across London, England.
A look at a murdered brunette who was left inside a burned-out car in the high desert.
A mistress hires a group of derelicts to kill the wife of her lover. Later, she plays the victim and denies any involvement.
A look at a seductress who kills two Georgia policemen for their life insurance benefits.
A state employee abducts women and keeps them captive.
A serial killer lays siege to Jacksonville, Florida. This murderer operates with impunity, thinking he is above the law, until the sins of his past come back to haunt him and justice is served.
A look at a wayward son who goes on a shooting spree, killing five people from two families.
A look at a woman who was murdered inside her rural Louisiana home.
A look at the murder of a British landlord and his tenant.
A look at a serial killer who murders victims with his pre-stashed weapons.

In Cumbria, 2010 taxi driver Derek Bird took his gun and, in less than 24 hours, shot dead 12 people and injured 11 more. The callous killer only stopped when he had run out of ammunition, finally turning the gun on himself.
In 2010, Derek Bird took his gun and, in less than twenty-four hours, killed twelve people and injured eleven more. He stopped when he had run out of ammunition, finally turning the gun on himself.
Danny Rolling, known as the Gainesville Ripper, murdered five university students in Florida in 1990. Rolling also confessed to murdering a family in his hometown of Shreveport, Louisiana.
Dennis Rader, known to the World as the BTK Killer, killed ten people, including young children, between 1974 and 1991 in Wichita, Kansas.
30-year-old Trevor Hardy, known as The Beast of Manchester, killed three teenage girls in a series of brutal attacks in the mid to late 1970s and was one of Britain’s longest-serving prisoners.
When police find a young college student murdered in Mission Viejo, they have no idea that it is just the start off a cross country killing spree.
A former U.S. Olympic medalist is shot dead in his yard when he goes outside to inspect a mysterious noise, but police discover his murderer was known to him.
A series of seemingly random shootings have terrorized the city of East Point, Georgia, just outside Atlanta. Police are baffled by the killer's motive and how he is choosing his victims.

A popular teenage girl is found brutally stabbed to death in her car in a small Pennsylvania city. She wasn’t sexually assaulted, but as police look closer, they discover she was involved in a shocking love triangle that breaks all the rules.
